overview:
**Students seeking to pursue Master’s in Mechanical Engineering in Switzerland** are offered the opportunity to pursue advanced technical education and research in a number of engineering fields.

Students can explore advanced study areas such as robotics, aerospace systems, automotive engineering, sustainable energy and advanced manufacturing. Specific specializations depend on university and program.

Note: Some schools such as ETH Zurich and EPFL have a specific degree called Master in Mechanical Engineering. Applicants are advised to check the entry requirements, language of instruction, curriculum and tuition fees of each program before applying.
